warnings: Pile caps on I-section piles I 0.18 x 0.18 (F1 one pile, F2 two piles), SAFE LOAD 13 t/pile; pile length not printed.
main_bar.count is the two-way total (section 6b). F1 is square 0.36 x 0.36, so depth_mm is omitted.

Depths below ระดับดินเดิม (1.00 to the cap top, cap 0.50, lean concrete 0.05, sand 0.05) are printed against a level that carries no value, so they stay on the elements (ground_reference, lean_concrete, sand_bed_thickness_m), not in the grid master z_levels.

Precast plank live load conflict: PS here prints >= 200 กก./ตร.ม., the A-01 notes print >= 150 กก./ตร.ม. Member spec follows the detail sheet (op01 precedence: detail beats general notes), so the PS note keeps 200 and the conflict is flagged on the element.
